description_en: Retrieves cost overview metrics for billing management
description_zh: 计费管理/获取成本概览指标
name: ModelRouterQueryCostOverviewMetrics

parameters.help_en: The start time, as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time, as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The model types, separated by commas
parameters.name: model_types

parameters.help_en: The department ID used to filter results
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.help_en: Optional. Filters by API key ID. This parameter works in conjunction with the department and requires clientId to be specified first
parameters.help_zh: 可选，按 API Key ID 过滤（与部门联动，需先指定 clientId）
parameters.name: api_key_id

parameters.help_en: Automatically aggregated. No input required. The granularity of the data. Valid values: hourly and daily. Default value: hourly
parameters.help_zh: 自动聚合，无需传入。粒度：hourly/daily，默认hourly
parameters.name: granularity

parameters.help_en: Optional. Filters by members (member IDs, separated by commas). If not specified, the department and all its members are included. If an empty value is specified, only the department is included without members
parameters.help_zh: 可选，按成员过滤（成员ID，多个用逗号分隔）。不传=部门及其全部成员；传空值=仅部门不含成员
parameters.name: member_user_ids

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return
parameters.name: max_results
